final_text:
Hi Darcey,

I hope you are having a great week and that operations are smooth while Rohan celebrates his wedding. My name is Marcos Gonzalez, and I am the Managing Attorney at GovSpring Legal, a small government contracts firm in downtown D.C. We regularly counsel firms on small business compliance matters. We have also had recent successes with several bid protests, strategizing around corrective actions that resulted in at least two direct awards to clients.

I would love to connect briefly to introduce myself properly and see how GovSpring Legal can support Nava as you continue this vital work for our veterans. Let me know if you would like to discuss any legal issues, free of charge. I'm available next week, and you can schedule a call here or call me at (202) 407-3556. You can also read more about my associate and I on our webpage.

I have CC'd my associate and some summer law clerks who would also participate in any scheduled call.

Best,
